description_en: Adds a group of users from the directory service to a call center instance
description_zh: 把目录服务中的一组用户添加到一个呼叫中心实例中
kebab_example: aliyun ccc assign-users --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --user-ram-id example-string --role-id example-string --skill-group-id example-string --skill-level 1 --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssignUsers

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center to which users are to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加用户的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The RAM ID of the user in the directory service to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的目录服务中的用户RAM ID
parameters.name: user_ram_id

parameters.help_en: The role ID of the newly added user
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group to which the user to be created belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建用户所归属的技能组ID
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The skill level of the user to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待创建用户所具有的技能级别
parameters.name: skill_level
